summary: Dispatches the vtable+8 (third-slot) method on up to three sub-objects held at this+0x20, this+0x24 and this+0x28. Each non-null slot is dispatched in order; the third dispatch's result is returned directly, otherwise the last executed dispatch result is returned. Unlike a destructor, it never nulls or frees the slot pointers.

local_names.this: owner object carrying the three sub-object pointers
local_names.v2: first sub-object pointer read from this+0x20
local_names.v4: second sub-object pointer read from this+0x24
local_names.v5: third sub-object pointer read from this+0x28

operations.description: Read the first sub-object pointer from this+0x20; dispatch only proceeds when it is non-null.
Call the vtable+8 (third-slot) method of the first sub-object and keep its return value as result.
Read the second sub-object pointer from this+0x24; dispatch only proceeds when it is non-null.
Call the vtable+8 (third-slot) method of the second sub-object and keep its return value as result.
Read the third sub-object pointer from this+0x28; dispatch only proceeds when it is non-null.
Call the vtable+8 (third-slot) method of the third sub-object; its return value is returned directly.
Return the last executed dispatch result: from the third slot when non-null, otherwise from the second or first, otherwise an uninitialized value.

unresolved: The concrete vtable+8 (third-slot) method of each sub-object is an indirect call resolved at runtime; its identity and resource-releasing semantics are unknown from this packet.
This function never releases ownership by nulling the slots; who owns the pointers after dispatch is unknown.
result can be read uninitialized when all three slots are null.
